title: Reformulating KV Cache Eviction Problem for Long-Context LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2605.07234v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) support long-context inference but suffer from substantial memory and runtime overhead due to Key-Value (KV) Cache growth. Existing KV Cache eviction methods primarily rely on local attention weights, neglecting the influence of value representations, output projection, and inter-head interactions. In this work, we reformulate KV Cache eviction from a conventional head-wise, weight-averaging approach into an output-aware, layer-wise matrix multiplication approximation problem. We introduce LaProx, a novel eviction strategy that explicitly models the multiplicative interaction between attention maps and projected value states to accurately quantify token contributions while accounting for inter-head dependencies. translated_title: 面向长上下文大语言模型推理的KV缓存淘汰问题重构
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）支持长上下文推理，但由于键值（KV）缓存的增长而面临巨大的内存和运行时开销。现有的KV缓存淘汰方法主要依赖局部注意力权重，忽略了价值表示、输出投影以及注意力头间相互作用的影响。在这项工作中，我们将KV缓存淘汰问题从传统的按头权重平均方法重新表述为一个输出感知的、按层的矩阵乘法近似问题。我们提出了LaProx，一种新颖的淘汰策略，它显式地对注意力图与投影价值状态之间的乘性交互进行建模，从而在考虑注意力头间依赖关系的同时，准确量化每个token的贡献。基于这一度量指标，我们提出了首个统一的淘汰策略，为token分配全局可比的重要性分数，从而实现模型级别的整体选择，而非局部的按头决策。
tldr: 该论文提出LaProx方法，将KV缓存淘汰从按头权重平均重新表述为输出感知的按层矩阵乘法近似问题，通过显式建模注意力图与价值投影的乘性交互并考虑头间依赖，首次实现了全局可比的token重要性评分与模型级统一淘汰策略。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LaProx, which reformulates KV cache eviction from head-wise weight averaging into an output-aware, layer-wise matrix multiplication approximation problem, explicitly modeling the multiplicative interaction between attention maps and projected value states to enable the first unified eviction strategy with globally comparable token importance scores.
